一夜安静无话。

谢辞看着腕表大概计算了一下时间，说：“这里白天与晚上的时间一致，都是六小时。”

“那我们抓紧时间，第一个白天夜晚基本上什么收获都没有。”靳兰珏看向众人，提议。

“今天白天我们分组搜查线索，按照寻常密室的规则，一般都是拼凑出这个场景曾经发生的事情真相，就可以通关了。”

谢辞颔首，视线在几人身上扫过，说：

“吴毅安和苏怀瑾一组，负责二楼。

周玉和你一组吧，你们去三楼。

我自己去一楼，走廊两边好像是教室，我再去检查一下看看。”

靳兰珏没有意见。

众人四散开，各自干活。

周玉打头，两人直奔三楼。

三楼的光线比二楼还差。

走廊外，正对着大槐树最茂盛的树冠，密集的树枝上面叶片绿油油的，将清晨的光线挡得严严实实。

周玉推开一扇门，咋舌：

“怪不得这楼里面采光这么差呢。”

靳兰珏上前一看，室内一片昏暗，一扇窗户都没有。

唯一的光线来源，只有走廊上昏暗的日光，阴暗又压抑。

这里似乎是一间教师的办公室。

四张桌子拼在房间正中间，每张桌子上摆着东西的风格都不一样。

靳兰珏走进房间，看到右手边的墙壁上，挂着两张地图，分别是世界地图和国家地图。

很有九十年代教室那味道了。

距离门口最近的桌子上摆着一本摊开的教案，周玉随手翻了翻，老师工整的笔迹很漂亮，不由感叹：

“嚯，当老师的写字儿就是不一样。

不像我，因为写字太难看，每次作文只有五分。”

靳兰珏看了他一眼，继续快速检查整个办公室，还不忘哼笑一声：

“你只写了一百字吧？”

周玉不干了：

“三百！

每次我都一定能凑三百个字的！一个字一个字数的！”

靳兰珏斜睨他一眼：

It was a quiet night.

Xie Ci looked at his watch and roughly calculated the time and said, "The time here during the day and at night are the same, both are six hours."

"Then let's hurry up. Basically we won't gain anything in the first day and night." Jin Lanjue looked at the crowd and suggested.

"Today during the day, we were divided into groups to search for clues. According to the rules of ordinary secret rooms, we usually piece together the truth of what happened in this scene, and then we can pass the level."

He nodded in thanks, glanced at several people, and said:

"Wu Yi'an and Su Huaijin are in charge of the second floor.

Zhou Yu will join your team. You go to the third floor.

I went to the first floor by myself. There seemed to be classrooms on both sides of the corridor. I went to check again."

Jin Lanjue has no objection.

Everyone dispersed and worked on their own.

Zhou Yu took the lead and the two of them went straight to the third floor.

The light on the third floor is worse than on the second floor.

Outside the corridor, facing the lushest crown of the big locust tree, the dense green leaves on the branches tightly block the early morning light.

Zhou Yu pushed open a door and was speechless:

"No wonder the lighting in this building is so poor."

Jin Lanjue stepped forward and took a look. The room was dark and there was no window.

The only source of light was the dim sunlight in the corridor, which was dark and depressing.

This seems to be a teacher's office.

Four tables were placed in the middle of the room, with things placed on each table in a different style.

Jin Lanjue walked into the room and saw two maps hanging on the wall on the right, namely a world map and a country map.

It feels very much like a classroom in the 1990s.

There was an open lesson plan on the table closest to the door. Zhou Yu flipped through it casually. The teacher's neat handwriting was very beautiful, and he couldn't help but sigh:

"Oh, writing as a teacher is different.

Unlike me, because the writing is too ugly, I only get five points for each composition."

Jin Lanjue glanced at him and continued to check the entire office quickly, not forgetting to laugh:

"You only wrote a hundred words, right?"

Zhou Yu quits:

"Three hundred!

I will definitely be able to come up with 300 words every time!Word by word!"
